M3b (referral decline) — live Supabase, 28 Aug 2026, BEFORE apply

BASELINE (to be confirmed immediately before applying)
  counselling_referrals.declined_at : absent
  referral_decline()                : absent
  counselling_referrals rows        : 0
  counsellor_clients rows           : 0
  referral_fact_list keys           : referred_on, accepted_on, from, to

THE PREDICTION — written before applying

  CHANGES
    counselling_referrals gains ONE column, declined_at, plus a constraint
    that a referral cannot be both accepted and declined, plus a partial index
    on genuinely open referrals.
    ONE new function: referral_decline(uuid).
    TWO EXISTING FUNCTIONS ARE REPLACED:
      referral_accept()    gains a refusal for an already-declined referral
      referral_fact_list() gains declined_on and an `outcome` word

  DOES NOT CHANGE
    No caseload link, no booking, no note, no policy, no other grant.
    All row counts unchanged — there are no referrals on live to act on.

  IF IT IS WRONG
    The realistic failure is a decline that will not record: visible and
    harmless. There is NO dangerous direction here — declining grants nobody
    access to anything, and the function is asserted at apply time not to
    write to counsellor_clients at all.

  EXPECTED AFTER-STATE, EXACTLY
    declined_at present, referral_decline present,
    referral_fact_list carrying declined_on and outcome,
    every row count identical, no reason-shaped column anywhere.
